video_caption: In this segment, Amy Selikoff, a woman with blonde hair wearing a grey blazer, a purple top, and a colorful striped scarf, is seen speaking. Initially, she is shown in a close-up shot, making hand gestures and looking thoughtfully as she speaks. The text "AMY SELIKOFF" is overlaid on the screen. The scene then transitions to a wider shot, revealing her standing on a stage at a TEDx event. She is positioned on a circular red rug in front of a large red "TEDx" sign. Behind her, a large screen displays the word "weird" in black text against a light blue background, which is part of her presentation. The date and location of the event, "OCT 2012 ORLANDOFLORIDA," are displayed at the bottom of the screen.

A young woman with shoulder-length blonde hair, dressed in a grey blazer over a purple top, dark blue jeans, and a colorful patterned scarf, stands on a stage, delivering a talk. She holds a small black object in her right hand and uses animated hand gestures and facial expressions throughout her speech. At various points, the camera zooms in on her upper body, highlighting her engaging demeanor, before zooming out to reveal the full stage. The stage is set with large red block letters spelling "TEDx". Behind her, a large screen displays different visuals: initially a solid light blue, then a school hallway with blue lockers and a clock (from 0:09 to 0:14), and finally a light blue and white abstract design from 0:41 to the end. She consistently maintains eye contact with the audience and displays a range of expressions from serious thoughtfulness to cheerful smiles, particularly when recounting anecdotes or making a point.

A woman with shoulder-length blonde hair, wearing a grey blazer over a purple top with a colorful patterned scarf and blue trousers, stands on a red circular rug on a stage. She holds a small black remote in her left hand, using animated gestures and expressive facial expressions as she speaks into a microphone. Large red letters spelling "TEDx" are visible on the stage floor to her left. Behind her, a large screen initially displays a plain light blue background. At 00:23, the screen transitions to a topographical map showing a landmass with mountainous and coastal features. At 00:46, two labels appear on the map: "Lake Titicaca" with an arrow pointing to a large lake, and "Lake Poopo" (Lake Poopó) with an arrow pointing to a smaller lake. The woman smiles amusedly, looking at the map and then back at the audience, implying that the lake names are humorous. The camera alternates between close-up shots of the woman and wider shots of the stage, revealing dark silhouettes of the audience members.

The video opens with a close-up of a woman with blonde hair, wearing a grey blazer, a patterned purple and red scarf, and a purple shirt, speaking directly to the camera. She holds a small black remote in her hands and smiles frequently, using hand gestures to emphasize her points. The background is a mix of dark and a bright, light-blue screen. At 0:21, the camera pulls back to reveal a wider shot of a stage. The woman is standing on a red circular carpet with "TEDx" visible in white letters on the floor in front of her. The stage is dark, flanked by black curtains. Behind her, the large screen now displays a diagram of a human brain with different lobes highlighted in various colors and labeled with Chinese characters. The labels include: 額葉 (éyè - Frontal Lobe), 頂葉 (dǐngyè - Parietal Lobe), 顳葉 (nièyè - Temporal Lobe), 枕葉 (zhěnyè - Occipital Lobe), and 小腦 (xiǎonǎo - Cerebellum). Additionally, 外側溝 (wàicè gōu - Lateral Sulcus) is partially visible. The camera then zooms back in on the woman, who continues to speak with animated expressions and gestures, holding the remote, with the screen and dark background visible behind her.

The video opens with a medium shot of a young woman standing before a large light blue screen. She has shoulder-length blonde hair with bangs, and is wearing a gray blazer over a dark top, paired with a colorful scarf featuring patterns in purple, blue, red, and yellow. She wears a ring on her left hand and holds a small black remote control in her left hand, gesturing actively with both hands as she speaks with a serious and engaged expression. At 0:09, the video transitions to a split image of an old illustration: on the left, a man in a dark suit is slumped in a green armchair in a room with brown curtains and a portrait on the wall; on the right, the same man is in a purple armchair, looking distressed with his hand on his head. At 0:16, the video cuts back to the woman, still in a medium shot, continuing her speech with varied hand gestures. Finally, at 0:28, the shot widens to reveal the woman standing on a circular red stage, now seen full-body. She is wearing dark blue jeans and light-colored flat shoes. Behind her are large red block letters spelling "TEDx", and the screen above her displays a blurry image with light colors. She continues to speak and gesture throughout this wider shot.

A blonde woman, wearing a grey blazer, a colorful patterned scarf, dark blue pants, and light-colored shoes, stands on a stage with a red circular carpet and large red "TEDx" letters in front of her. Behind her is a large light blue screen, flanked by dark curtains. She is actively speaking, using various hand gestures, including raising her index finger, opening her palms, and clasping her hands, with animated facial expressions throughout the segment. At 0:04, a brown clenched fist appears on the screen behind her, which later disappears, returning to a plain light blue background. A black monitor is visible on the stage floor in front of the TEDx letters, and an audience can be seen in the dimly lit foreground in wider shots.

The video segment opens with a close-up shot of a blonde-haired woman, wearing a gray blazer, a colorful patterned scarf, and dark pants, speaking directly to the camera. She holds a black remote control in her left hand and uses hand gestures to emphasize her points, appearing engaged and serious yet approachable as she discusses students' self-learning. Behind her, a large screen displays a plain light blue background, and the prominent red "TEDx" logo is visible on the stage floor beneath her. At 0:18, the shot widens to show the entire stage, revealing the woman standing on a red circular rug, continuing to speak and gesture. The screen behind her now displays a large brown square with a white question mark inside, while the dark auditorium shows the silhouettes of the audience.

A woman with light brown hair, wearing a gray blazer, purple top, dark pants, and light flat shoes, stands on a dark stage with a large red circular rug under her feet. To her left are large, red 3D letters spelling "TEDx". She is speaking, holding her hands clasped in front of her, and occasionally gesturing. Behind her, a large screen initially displays a brown square icon with a large white question mark inside, set against a light blue background with a reflection below the icon. Around the 0:14 mark, a second icon appears to the right of the question mark: a white square with a stylized black fist and a lightning bolt symbol inside, also with a reflection. The audience is dimly visible in the foreground, seated in darkness.

The video opens with a wide shot of a woman with blonde hair, wearing a grey blazer, a colorful patterned scarf, and dark pants, standing on a red circular stage. In front of her, the "TEDx" logo is prominently displayed on the stage floor. Behind her, a large screen shows two square icons: a brown one with a white question mark, and a light blue one with a white raised fist. She gestures with her hands as she speaks. The camera then zooms in for a closer shot, focusing on the woman's upper body and expressive face. She holds a small, dark remote in her left hand, using both hands for emphasis. Her expression is engaged and serious. This view lasts for several seconds before transitioning to a black and white image of a historical scientific illustration. The illustration depicts a man in a suit examining a laboratory apparatus, which appears to be a bell jar with a tube. Text above the illustration reads "70 INORGANIC CHEMISTRY. Fig. 159." with a caption below stating, "Testing the currents of air to and from gases." After a few seconds, the video cuts back to the close-up shot of the woman on stage, who continues to speak with dynamic hand gestures.

A young woman with light brown hair, wearing a grey blazer, a purple top, a multi-colored patterned scarf, dark pants, and light-colored flat shoes, stands on a stage with large red "TEDx" letters in the foreground. She holds a small black object in her left hand and gestures with both hands as she speaks, occasionally smiling. Behind her is a dark curtain and a large light blue screen. At 00:16, the scene transitions to a sepia-toned historical photograph depicting two figures in dark clothing walking through a vast, snow-covered landscape with large chunks of ice. They appear to be pulling or pushing small boats or sleds over the uneven icy terrain.

The video begins with a sepia-toned historical photograph (0:00-0:03) depicting two figures, likely men in heavy winter clothing, navigating a harsh, snow-and-ice-covered landscape. They appear to be pulling sleds laden with gear, suggesting an expedition in a polar or arctic environment. This static image then transitions to a live shot (0:03-0:31) of a young woman with shoulder-length blonde hair, wearing a grey blazer, a multicolored patterned scarf, and dark trousers. She is speaking passionately, using expressive hand gestures to emphasize her words, and holding a small black remote with a green light in her left hand. She stands on a stage with a large, light blue screen behind her, lit by a spotlight. As she continues to speak, the camera zooms out and pans down (0:31-0:34), revealing the full stage setup, including large red letters spelling "TEDX" on a circular red carpet where she stands, confirming the context of her talk.

A woman with light brown hair, wearing a grey blazer, a colorful patterned scarf, and dark pants, stands on a stage with a red circular carpet. She holds a small black remote in her left hand and gestures with both hands as she speaks passionately to an unseen audience, her facial expressions animated and engaging. Behind her are large red letters spelling "TEDx," and a large screen displaying a light blue background. She smiles as she finishes speaking, and the audience applauds. The scene then transitions to a black screen with white text that reads "TEDx Orlando" (with the "x" in orange), followed by "x = independently organized TED event." This text then changes to display "Video production by Orange TV" and "Post-production by Orange TV and Jenny Zoe Casey."
